schema.title: Response Analyses Api Conversations  Name  Analyses Get
Response Listing Api Datasets  Dataset Id  Conversations Get
Response Artifacts Api Conversations  Name  Artifacts Get

id.title: Id
id.description: URL-safe UUID, stored as 32 hexadecimal characters

design.title: Design
design.description: the design run the artifact is about; null when it is about the data before any run

data_version.title: Data Version
data_version.description: the version of the table it was made from; 0 is the uploaded file

ask.title: Ask
ask.description: what was asked for, in the person's words

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: what it shows, in words; a picture's caption

facts.title: Facts
facts.description: every number it stands behind, by name

files.title: Files
files.description: the file names in its folder

table.title: Table
table.description: the table file's name in the folder, when it wrote one

context.title: Context
context.description: JSON-encoded original text, preserving line endings through browser multipart serialization

key_search_limit.title: Key Search Limit
key_search_limit.default: All single columns; pairs among at most 12 non-single keys by descending cardinality, then source position. No larger combinations.

DecisionView.title: DecisionView
DecisionView.description: The routing's decision as the page shows it.

DeclineView.title: DeclineView
DeclineView.description: Where the lane did not take the pack as given.

Edge.title: Edge
Edge.description: One arrow of a graph figure, with the addresses it rests on.

FeasibilityView.title: FeasibilityView
FeasibilityView.description: Where and why a lane stopped.

note.title: Note
note.description: one sentence on what the figure shows, in the question's words

draws_on.title: Draws On
draws_on.description: the memory and probe addresses the figure rests on

Mark.title: Mark
Mark.description: A reference line: the cutoff, the change period, a floor.

Node.title: Node
Node.description: One node of a graph figure: a column, or the hidden factor.

RequirementBinding.title: RequirementBinding
RequirementBinding.description: A catalogue field bound to this statement, never a separately writable claim.

figures.title: Figures
figures.description: what the run left, in the order the chat shows them

key.title: Key
key.description: The series' address segment, computed here once so the page never rebuilds it.

Series.title: Series
Series.description: One drawn set of values. `x` is a level, a period, or a bin; `y` the number; `lo`/`hi` an interval; `n` the rows behind each point.
